services.faqTitle: A few things you might be wondering.

faq.q: How much will my project cost?
faq.a: It depends on the scope, content, integrations and level of design. Tell me what you have in mind, and we can discuss an approach and an estimate before work begins.

faq.q: Can you improve an existing website?
faq.a: Yes. Share your current website and what is getting in the way. We can look at the interface, performance, content structure or a specific feature.

faq.q: Do I need a finished specification?
faq.a: No. A short explanation of your business, the problem and what you want to achieve is a useful starting point.
You'll speak directly with me, Oleksandr. O.D. EMPOWER is my independent development studio, so the person discussing the project is also the person building it.
